1:1 Coaching for Music Creatives

The best version of you is still unreleased.

It's not about the music. It's about you.

The Unreleased Artist is for every music creative who has been doing this alone. Whether you are working through something that has kept you stuck, navigating a project or decision with no one who truly understands it, or building something real and wanting a genuine thinking and action partner alongside you every step of the way. Songwriters, performers, producers, engineers, music business professionals, music entrepreneurs, students, educators, artists building a brand — anyone in the music world who is doing it without the right support around them.

What you build here will serve you far beyond the music. The inner work goes with you.

Music creatives don't think in a straight line. They think, feel, and operate differently — and the support around them needs to understand that before it can actually help.

Most frameworks, systems, and coaching models weren't built for the way you actually work. This one was.

What we work on

Whether you are working through something or building toward something. Both.

Before anything else — a word about the word coaching. You have probably seen the life coaches. The manifestation content. The people who tell you that mindset is everything and leave you no closer to actually moving. That is not this.

What we do here is go beneath the surface of what is actually getting in the way — specifically for music creatives — and then build the real plan to move through it. Not a framework applied to whoever sits in front of me. Not a single piece of generic advice that could apply to anyone. Work that is built entirely around you.

For some people that means finding what is really stopping things and moving through it. For others it means having a genuine thinking and action partner alongside the work — someone invested in where you are going, helping you navigate decisions, and holding you accountable to what matters.

Real steps. Real timelines. Real accountability. Real follow through. Because knowing what is stopping you is only the beginning. And having someone genuinely alongside the work changes everything.

I
Inner work & mindset

Uncovering the real reasons you're where you are. The fear, the doubt, the limiting beliefs, the patterns. Named honestly and worked through.

II
Plans & strategy

Real executable plans built around your goals, your life, and your definition of success. Not generic advice — specific strategy that actually fits.

III
Accountability & delivery

Consistent follow through between sessions from someone with real program management and delivery experience. This is accountability that actually holds.

IV
Your version of success

We start by defining what success looks like for you — not the industry version. Yours. Everything we build is built toward that.

Work with me

There are different ways to work together.

Each one is built around you. Your goals, your life, your definition of success, and what you actually need right now. Not a one-size-fits-all approach — a coaching relationship tailored specifically to where you are and where you want to go.

I built this because I wished it existed.

Daniel J. Ryder

I've been a singer, songwriter, artist, performer, producer, and multi-instrumentalist at different stages of my life. I know what it feels like to carry a creative vision alone alongside a career directing high-level programs and projects across industries, raising a family, and doing every role yourself.

What I eventually understood is that the reason things don't move is almost never the reason that looks like the reason. It goes beneath the surface. To the beliefs, the fears, the patterns, the identity. That's where the real work is.

But the inner work alone isn't enough. I've spent a career learning what it actually takes to deliver something, not just in music but across industries and in roles that each carry their own weight and demands. You need the plan. The structure. The accountability. Someone who understands the work, the roles, and the real effort they require. That's what The Unreleased Artist delivers. The inner work and the outer plan. Both. Not one without the other.

You already know what it feels like to work with someone who says they care and then delivers something that proves they didn't. Where the detail disappeared when it mattered most. Where the investment that showed up in the first conversation quietly vanished when the real work began. This is not that relationship. When we work together I know your work, your vision, and your story specifically. Not a version of it. Not a pattern I recognise from someone else. Yours. I bring the same level of attention on the last session as I do on the first. Because this is not a job to me. It is the work I built this for.

This is your journey at your pace built around how you think and how you naturally move through things. The accountability is real and the results are the point. And what you build here will serve you far beyond the music. The inner work goes with you into every area of your life. This is not just about your music career. It is about the person living it.

Professional & Executive Coach  ·  Program & Project Director  ·  Singer, Songwriter & Artist  ·  College Educator  ·  Mentor & Consultant
